# Technology radar

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-radar.js — do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Run `npm run build-radar` after changing data/technologies.json or a role file. -->

Derived from the **Technology Proficiency Levels** sections of 226 role definitions, against the curated vocabulary in `data/technologies.json`. Generated 2026-08.

## What this radar says, and what it does not

**It says what the organisation staffs for.** A technology sits here because role definitions expect people to be good at it, and its ring reflects how many roles expect that and at what depth:

| Ring | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| **Adopt** | Expected at Expert or Proficient level in 10 or more roles |
| **Trial** | Expected at Expert or Proficient level in fewer than 10 roles |
| **Assess** | Named mostly at Working Knowledge or Awareness level |
| **Hold** | *Empty, and not derivable — see below* |

**It does not say what to adopt.** A conventional radar carries a recommendation; this one carries an observation. Nothing in a role definition says "stop using this", so **the Hold ring has no source in this repository** and is deliberately empty rather than guessed. Filling it is a judgement someone must make and sign, not something the catalogue can be squeezed to produce.

A count here is also not a licence count or a spend signal. It counts role definitions, and a role definition may describe one person or thirty.
